items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Ozzie Nelson had the job... 'You get a band together and we'll put you in here for one night... if you make a good impression we'll see about getting you in to follow him'

ctx.x: Well, Milton Romer booked your band, is that right? He was your manager or what?

He was the manager. In those days it was -- it wasn't much of a definition of who was a manager and who was a booker. The laws weren't too stringent about that. Like he did this directly. It wasn't done through any office. He still had Ozzie Nelson, who was very big at the time, you know. He had a commercial radio program and doing this thing.
Did you have any association with him after he pulled that on you in New Orleans?
